title: Amazon Aurora DSQL CDC to Amazon EventBridge with Amazon EventBridge Pipes
description: An Amazon EventBridge pipe filters and reshapes Amazon Aurora DSQL change records from Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Event bus rules send inserts and deletes to Amazon SQS.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Amazon Aurora DSQL writes a change record for every committed row change to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams.

An Amazon EventBridge pipe reads the stream, drops chunked and fragment records, uses the record's operation code (c, u or d) as the event type and puts the reshaped change on an Amazon EventBridge custom event bus.

Rules on the event bus send every change to an audit queue, inserts to a validation queue and deletes to an alerts queue in Amazon SQS. Dead-letter queues catch records the pipe cannot deliver and events a rule target cannot accept.
